Hello again Chichinomori!

I would like to request another full-colour commission about Ursula from [ボクが魔王の息子だからってパイズリで退治しないで下さい!]:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1g5EVSe9sdi0odQON2bn-XjE-hOyb949-

The situation would be paizuri sex on the beach. Noto is lying down on his back while Ursula is dutifully giving him a paizuri. Ursula is delighted to be on a summer vacation with her husband. Ursula was concerned about Noto overworking himself with his royal duty. But now, Noto can finally relax to his heart content, and Ursula is more than happy to give him some paizuri service. The mood is lovey dovey and lewd.

Ursula is wearing a purple bikini. Her hair are adorned with a white hibiscus flower.

As usual, I would like an ejaculation variation and a textless version, please.

Thank you very much for your consideration!
